verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents plugging in multiple providers via librechat.yaml custom endpoints: OpenRouter, Ollama, and OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible services. Its agents are described as powered by various model providers with broader model support than OpenAI's GPTs, and an endpoint menu lets users choose backends in chat. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Google/Gemini support, explicit documentation of switching models mid-conversation or setting a model per agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider switching.
